_comment: S3 bucket policy: allows ONLY your CloudFront distribution (via Origin Access Control) to read objects. The bucket stays fully private otherwise. Replace BUCKET_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID (12-digit, from `aws sts get-caller-identity`), and DISTRIBUTION_ID (from the CloudFront console). Apply at: S3 -> bucket -> Permissions -> Bucket policy -> Edit. CloudFront also offers a 'Copy policy' button when you create the distribution (§5.3) — either works. See AWS_MIGRATION_GUIDE.md §5.3.
